article.full_text: How to watch IND vs ZIM T20I 2026 live: Start time, TV channels and streaming details as Vaibhav Sooryavanshi returns originally appeared on Cricket News. Add Cricket News as a Preferred Source by clicking here. India plays three T20Is in Zimbabwe from July 23 to July 26, 2026. All matches take place at the Harare Sports Club starting at 4:30 p.m. IST. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi returns as India looks to end a six-match losing streak. India travels to Harare for a three-match T20I series carrying an unwanted record, having failed to win a single game in the format since being crowned T20 World Cup champions in March, a run that now stretches to six straight defeats. Those losses came in Ireland and England, where Shreyas Iyer's side were swept 2-0 and then whitewashed 4-0, costing India their world No. 1 T20I ranking and prompting serious questions about the direction of the team. Zimbabwe therefore offers a chance to reset. India arrives with a young, heavily rotated squad designed to test bench strength, with several senior players rested and two uncapped names in line for debuts. MORE:Abhinav Mukund picks 15-man India squad for 2027 ODI World Cup Vaibhav Sooryavanshi retains his place after a difficult introduction to international cricket, having managed just 42 runs in three innings against England before being dropped for the series finale at Southampton in favour of Sanju Samson. Samson has been rested for this tour, meaning the 15-year-old is expected to open alongside Abhishek Sharma. Rinku Singh returns to the setup for the first time since the T20 World Cup, while Mayank Yadav is back after last playing for India in late 2024. Yash Thakur and Ashok Sharma have earned maiden call-ups, and Harsh Dubey and Prabhsimran Singh will hope for debuts. Ravi Bishnoi came into the squad as a replacement for Varun Chakaravarthy, who was ruled out with a hamstring injury sustained against England. Zimbabwe are led by Sikandar Raza and will fancy their chances in home conditions, with Blessing Muzarabani, Richard Ngarava, and Brian Bennett among the more familiar names in a settled home squad. MORE:Fitness emergency! Nearly a dozen Indian stars called to CoE India squad: Shreyas Iyer (c), Tilak Varma (vc), Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, Abhishek Sharma, Ishan Kishan (wk), Prabhsimran Singh (wk), Shivam Dube, Suryansh Shedge, Rinku Singh, Harsh Dubey, Ravi Bishnoi, Prince Yadav, Yash Thakur, Ashok Sharma, Mayank Yadav Zimbabwe squad: Sikandar Raza (c), Brian Bennett, Ryan Burl, Ben Curran, Brad Evans, Clive Madande (wk), Tinotenda Maposa, Tadiwanashe Marumani, Wellington Masakadza, Tashinga Musekiwa, Blessing Muzarabani, Dion Myers, Richard Ngarava, Newman Nyamhuri, Milton Shumba * Some broadcasts and streaming services will be subject to local scheduling and may vary by territory. All three matches of the T20I series between Zimbabwe and India will be shown live on Zee's Unite8 Sports Network, with live streaming available through the FanCode app and website. MORE:'English cricket is more important than IPL' - Cook and Babat in heated debate over Bethell In Zimbabwe, the IND vs ZIM T20I series 2026 will be telecast live on ZBC TV, while live streaming will be on ZBC digital platforms. While there is no confirmed telecast, cricket fans in the United Kingdom and Ireland will be able to live stream the Zimbabwe vs India T20I series on Hotstar UK. In the United States and Canada, the matches are available to watch on Willow TV (TV and live streaming).
